Their way is like that of Pharaoh's people and those before them, who denied Allah's signs and were seized for their sins.
Similar situations have passed before, so travel the earth and see the end of those who denied.
Messengers before were ridiculed and the mockers were overtaken by what they mocked; travel through the land and see the end of the deniers.
Nations before were seized with poverty and hardship to humble them; when they hardened and forgot, Allah opened every good to them, then seized them suddenly and eliminated the wrongdoers.
Many cities were destroyed, the punishment coming at night or while they slept at noon, and their only cry was that they had been wrongdoers.
Cities that denied their prophets were tried with hardship, then ease, then seized suddenly; had they believed, blessings would have opened, and none should feel secure from Allah's plan.
Like Pharaoh's people and those before them, they denied Allah's signs and were destroyed for their sins; Allah does not change a favor on a people until they change themselves.
Like earlier, stronger and richer peoples, they enjoy their portion and their deeds become worthless; the peoples of Noah, 'Aad, Thamud, Abraham, Madyan and the overturned towns wronged themselves.
Generations before were destroyed when they did wrong and would not believe their messengers' clear proofs; then you were made successors in the land to see how you would act.
The Prophet tells them to observe the heavens and earth, but signs avail nothing for disbelievers, who await only what befell those before; Allah saves His messengers and believers.
These are the stories of cities, some still standing and some mown down; they wronged themselves, their gods did not help them, and the Lord's seizure is painful and severe.
Few in the generations before forbade corruption, while the wrongdoers pursued their luxury; the Lord would not destroy cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
Messengers before were ridiculed too; Allah gave the disbelievers time, then seized them, and terrible was His penalty.
The peoples of Noah, 'Aad, Thamud and those after doubted their messengers and threatened to expel them; Allah promised to destroy the wrongdoers, and every obstinate tyrant faces Hell.
Earlier plotters had the roof fall on them when Allah came at their building's foundations, and on Resurrection Day He will disgrace them and ask where their partners are.
When Allah intends to destroy a city, its affluent defiantly disobey and it is destroyed completely, as many generations after Noah were.
Every city will be destroyed or punished before Resurrection Day; signs are held back because former peoples denied them, Thamud wronging the she-camel, and come only as warning.
Many generations before them were destroyed, and not one of them can be seen or heard now.
They walk among the dwellings of many destroyed generations, which are signs for people of intelligence.
Many unjust cities were shattered and replaced; their people fled on sensing the punishment, confessing they were wrongdoers, until they were mown down and extinguished.
Before the Prophet, the peoples of Noah, 'Aad, Thamud, Abraham, Lot and Madyan denied, as Moses was denied; Allah let them enjoy, then seized them, leaving cities in ruin.
After Noah's people, a generation, said to be 'Aad or Thamud, rejects its messenger as a mere man and denies resurrection until the shriek seizes them.
Other generations follow, none able to advance or delay its term; each denies the messenger sent to it, so they are destroyed one after another and made into narrations.
Moses and Aaron's deniers were destroyed, Noah's people drowned, and 'Aad, Thamud, the companions of the well and many generations were destroyed, as was the town rained upon.
Allah destroyed many cities insolent in their living, leaving their dwellings empty, but never before sending a messenger to their mother city and only when their people were wrongdoers.
'Aad, Thamud, Qarun, Pharaoh and Haman were each seized for their sin, by stones, blast, the earth swallowing or drowning, wronged not by Allah but by themselves.
Earlier peoples were stronger and built more, yet they denied and ridiculed Allah's signs brought by their messengers, wronging themselves, so their end was the worst.
People are told to travel the land and see the end of those before them, most of whom associated others with Allah.
Many generations were destroyed before them, whose dwellings they walk among, and in that are signs, if they would hear.
Earlier peoples, given far more than these, also denied Allah's messengers, and how terrible was His reproach.
Traveling the land shows the end of earlier, stronger peoples, and nothing in the heavens or earth can thwart Allah.
Alas for the servants who ridiculed every messenger; many generations were destroyed and will not return, yet all will be brought before Allah.
Most former peoples went astray though warners were sent among them; see how the warned ended, except Allah's chosen servants.
The people of Noah, 'Aad, Pharaoh, Thamud, Lot's people and the companions of the thicket all denied the messengers, so Allah's penalty upon them was justified.
Those before them denied, and punishment came from where they did not perceive, bringing disgrace in this life, while the punishment of the Hereafter is greater.
Those before, stronger and more established in the land, disbelieved in the clear proofs their messengers brought, so Allah seized them for their sins.
Earlier, stronger nations rejoiced in their own knowledge and rejected their messengers; when they saw the punishment they believed in Allah alone, but that faith did not benefit them.
Those who turn away are warned of a thunderbolt like that of 'Aad and Thamud; arrogant 'Aad met a screaming wind, Thamud preferred blindness to guidance, and believers were saved.
Every prophet sent to former peoples was ridiculed, and Allah destroyed peoples greater in power than these.
Allah destroyed the cities around them after varied signs, and the deities they took besides Allah did not help them.
Noah's people, the companions of the well, Thamud, 'Aad, Pharaoh, Lot's brothers, the companions of the thicket and Tubba's people all denied the messengers and met the threat.
Allah destroyed many generations greater in power who explored the lands, with no escape; that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or listens attentively.
'Aad were destroyed by a barren wind, Thamud were seized by a thunderbolt after defying their Lord, and Noah's people before them were defiantly disobedient.
Allah destroyed the first 'Aad, Thamud and Noah's people, who were more unjust, and hurled down the overturned towns, then asks which of His favors people doubt.
Earlier disbelievers tasted the result of their deeds because they rejected their messengers' clear evidences, asking whether mere humans would guide them.
Many towns that defied their Lord and His messengers were severely punished and lost, so those of understanding should fear Allah, who has sent down the Quran.
Thamud and 'Aad, who denied the Striking Calamity, were destroyed by a blast and a violent wind; Pharaoh and the overturned cities were seized; ancestors were carried in a ship.
Allah destroyed the former peoples and will follow them with the later ones; thus He deals with criminals, and woe that Day to the deniers.
The story of the soldiers of Pharaoh and Thamud is recalled, yet disbelievers persist in denial while Allah encompasses them.
By the dawn and ten nights, Allah dealt with 'Aad of Iram, Thamud who carved rocks, and Pharaoh of the stakes, who spread corruption, pouring punishment upon them.
